text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame hasn't been in good form 
lately. To take a breather, she went for a 
walk to a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Trainer. Lately, they 
say this shrine... is "haunted."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That's right. At night, this shrine...――

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, you can hear thudding noises 
from inside the main hall, like someone 
banging on the walls: *thud*... *thud*...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing the noise, the head priest opened 
the doors of the main hall, and..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the slowly creaking open door, 
there stood...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
They say the floor, the walls, and even 
the ceiling were packed with horseshoe 
marks...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Some folks are saying this is a divine 
curse...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's just a rumor! Pretty much an 
urban legend, really.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, a divine curse, huh...? Maybe that 
just can't be helped... either?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well... you know how everyone's 
always asking you to grant their wishes?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The pressure is just immense... If it were 
me, I'd totally collapse under it~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe that thing from before was God 
screaming, 'I can't take this anymore~!' 
too.
choice_data_list: Then I'll have to take good care of you

Then I'll have to take good care of you, 
won't I?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You're right! In that case, let's tell 
them "Thank you for your hard work!" 
Hopefully it'll help ease their minds, 
even just a little.

I press my hands together in prayer with 
Dantsu Flame. And then...
(Rustle...)

A warm, gentle breeze blew through. The 
trees swayed softly in the wind.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...It seems to have disappeared.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, Cafe-chan! ...Um, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I want them to... "look" at me. The 
"thing" born from that single wish.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The sound from the main hall was proof of 
that. A wish for it to reach someone, no 
doubt. And now...—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...You probably won't hear any sounds 
coming from it anymore. Thank you for your 
hard work."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
…………Trainer. My shoulders have felt 
strangely light for a while now…….

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Did I do something wrong...?

Though the reason remained unknown, from 
that day on, Dants Flame began to regain 
her form.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Why? I-It was so bright just a moment 
ago...

text_block_list.name: Banging on the Wall
text_block_list.text: (THUD! ...THUD! THUD!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Th-This sound is...!
Da... nts...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh! ...H-Huh? It's back to normal...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Trainer, um, about earlier—
choice_data_list:
You spaced out all of a sudden. What's 
gotten into you?

You spaced out all of a sudden. What's the 
matter?

text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Dantz Flame's condition 
remained somewhat off.
